summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K incorporating an underwriting agreement dated July 30, 2026 for a public offering of 1,491,305 common shares. Northland Securities and Roth Capital Partners act as representatives of the underwriters. The offering is a routine equity issuance under a Canadian base shelf prospectus, with no special-situation elements such as a takeover, merger, or activist event. The filing is a standard capital raise, not a special situation, so it is classified as None.
